description: Act on an observe @ref (click, fill/type with text, hover, submit) or navigate to url, returning state diffs (changed.added descriptors, changed.removed refs, value changes, text delta). Actions are recorded for browser_agent_flow_save. Navigation triggers guard checks: guard {rule, host, mode} in result indicates secret_in_url (other site cookie), url_from_hidden (host only in hidden/suspect text), or outside_origins (CDPILOT_AGENT_ORIGINS); navigation still ran (warn) — stop and ask user before proceeding. Detected cookies are «redacted» in url.

text.description: Text value for fill or type actions

url.description: URL to navigate to instead of acting on a ref

name: browser_agent_act
